annotations.text: Direction A - Studio panel (the deliverable, Main). Warm charcoal from the Cardamom panel material, cream type, one amber accent for whatever is playing, red only for STOP ALL and trouble. Barlow for legibility across the studio. Tradeoff: the most restrained option, so a playing cart relies on the amber fill and outline rather than colour flooding.
Options B and C are low-fi sketches of the cart only, to choose a direction. Pick one, or keep A: the final goes into Main and these two get removed.
